items.title: 9.9 Bairooni electric field se bachao (shielding) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.9 with Fig. 9.19 (PDF 207-208).

blocks.text: Angrez scientist Michael Faraday ne 1836 mein ek dhancha ijad kiya jise Faraday cage ya Faraday shield kehte hain. Faraday cage aisa ihata (enclosure) hai jo conductive maaddon ke zariye bairooni electric fields ko rokta hai. Yeh khokhle conductor ki tarah kaam karta hai jis mein aalaat ya cheezein bairooni electric fields se hifazat ke liye rakhi ja sakti hain. Cage ko lagne wala koi bhi electrical jhatka (shock) us ki bahari sath se guzar jata hai aur nuqsan nahi karta; khokhle conductor ke andar electric field sifar rehti hai.

Faraday cage ka kaam samajhne ke liye maan lein conductor ke tukre (maslan copper) par kai zaid azaad electrons hain. Har electron par us ke padosi electrons ki electric field ki wajah se dafa ki force lagti hai; nateeje mein sab conductor ki sath ki taraf daurte hain. Jab sara zaid charge sath par aa kar saakin tawazun (static equilibrium) qaim ho jaye to charge ki mazeed harkat nahi hoti. Agar ragar waghaira se kuch electrons conductor se kisi aur cheez par chale jayein to conductor ki sath par khalis musbat charge zahir hota hai.

blocks.title: Conductor par charge
blocks.text: Electrostatic halaat mein tawazun par koi bhi zaid charge conductor ki sath par rehta hai.

Ab khokhle conductor ke andar ko dekhein. Zaid charges conductor ki sath par theek is tarah tarteeb lete hain ke andar kul field sifar ho jaye. Doosre lafzon mein conductor apne andar ke kisi bhi charge ko conductor ke bahar ki electric fields se bachata hai. Bairooni fields ki madakhlat (interference) khatam karne ke liye circuits aksar dhaat ke dabbon mein band kiye jate hain jo aisi fields se bachao dete hain.

Figure 9.19 ek aur pehlu dikhati hai ke conductors bairooni charges ki banai field lines ko kaise badalte hain. Lines is liye badalti hain ke tawazun par conductor ki sath ke bilkul bahar electric field sath ke amudi hoti hai. Agar field amudi na hoti to sath ke mutawazi field ka ek juz hota, aur sath ke azaad electrons us ke zor par chalte; magar haqeeqat mein tawazun par electrons ka bahao nahi hota, to koi mutawazi juz nahi ho sakta, aur field sath ke amudi hai.

blocks.alt: Baen + plate aur daen - plate ke darmiyan khokhla gol conductor. Us ke baen hisse par manfi aur daen hisse par musbat charges. Magenta lines baen se daen, mur kar sath se seedhe zaviye par milti hain; andar koi line nahi.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.19 (kitab ki Figure 9.19 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Bairooni field azaad electrons ko + plate wale kinare ki taraf kheenchti hai, is liye baen taraf manfi aur daen taraf musbat charge jama hota hai. Yeh charges andar ki field khatam kar dete hain, aur bahar lines sath par amudi milti hain.

Faraday cage ke usool ke liye aisa maadda chahiye jis mein bohat se azaad electrons hon jo maadde ki sath tak azaadi se ja sakein. Sirf conductors mein azaad electrons hote hain, insulators mein nahi, is liye insulators se Faraday cage nahi banaya ja sakta.

items: Gariyan: gariyon ke chassis aur dhaati dhanche wale jism toofan (thunderstorm) mein andar baithe logon ko bachate hain; electrical charge gari ki dhaati sath par se zameen mein chala jata hai.
Microwave oven: dhaati jism Faraday cage ka kaam karta hai aur microwaves ko mahaul mein phailne se rokta hai.
Hawai jahaz: jab hawai jahaz par bijli (lightning) girti hai to bijli us ke dhaati dhanche par phail jati hai, aur musafir aur andar ke tamam aalaat mehfooz rehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Faraday cage kin maaddon se banaya ja sakta hai, aur kyun (short question 9.9)? Hawai jahaz jaisa chalta conductor hawa mein urte hue charge kaise hasil karta hai (short question 9.1)?
blocks.explanation: Conductors jaise dhaatein (copper, aluminium, steel ki jaali), kyunke un mein azaad electrons hote hain jo sath par ja kar tab tak tarteeb lete hain jab tak andar field sifar na ho; insulators mein azaad electrons nahi, to woh yeh nahi kar sakte. Urte hue jahaz hawa, gard, pani ke qatron aur barf ke zarron se ragarta hai; yeh ragar electrons muntaqil karti hai, to us ka jism charged ho jata hai, aur charge us ki bahari dhaati sath par phail jata hai.

items: Faraday cage (1836): khokhla conductor; zaid charge sath par rehta aur aise tarteeb leta hai ke andar field sifar ho; bilkul bahar field sath se amudi milti hai. Sirf azaad electrons wale conductors kaam karte hain. Misalein: toofan mein gariyan, microwave ovens, bijli se takrate jahaz, circuits ke gird dhaat ke dabbe.
